scientific_integrity: Explicit estimates are analytic and independent of finite sampling; supplementary checks are not substitutes for proof.
scientific_limitations: Sharp only for Steiner-centered planar convex bodies of fixed perimeter 2π and circle geodesic W1; strict nonattainment. No claim on chordal transport, higher dimensions, or arbitrary centering. Primary source's kernel and upper estimate are reused with attribution; proof of sharpness and nonattainment is supplied. Historical priority provisional.
title: Sharp and unattained planar Minkowski inverse-Wasserstein Lipschitz constant
